Line Item #1 – Equipment
Furnish and deliver a complete LG Multi F Max ducted heat pump system for a four-zone application serving the basement, first floor, and second floor (divided into two subzones). Equipment package includes:

Zone 1 & 2 (Basement and First Floor)

(1) LG 42K BTU Multi-Zone Outdoor Unit (Model: LGKUMXA421A)

(1) LG 36K BTU Ducted Air Handler, Vertical/Horizontal Mount (Model: LGKNMLB361A)

(1) LG 9K BTU Ducted Indoor Unit for Basement (Model: LGKNUAB091A)

(1) LG 2-Port Distribution Box (Model: LGPMBD3620ZR)

Zone 3 & 4 (Second Floor Split)

(1) LG 36K BTU Multi-Zone Outdoor Unit (Model: LGKUMXA361A)

(1) LG 12K BTU Ducted Air Handler, Vertical/Horizontal Mount (Model: LGKNMLB121A)

(1) LG 24K BTU Ducted Air Handler, Vertical/Horizontal Mount (Model: LGKNMLB241A)

(1) LG 2-Port Distribution Box (Model: LGPMBD3620ZR)

Controls

(4) LG Deluxe Wi-Fi Thermostats (Model: LGPREMTA201)

All equipment to be installed in accordance with manufacturer specifications and local code requirements. Accessories, refrigerant line sets, and mounting hardware to be provided separately.

Line Item #2 – Labor
Labor to install (2) LG Multi-Zone heat pump systems serving four independently zoned areas across three levels of the home (basement, first floor, and second floor). Scope of work includes:

Complete installation of ducted air handlers and outdoor condensing units.

Interconnection of equipment via refrigerant line sets, control wiring, and drain piping.

Installation of (4) thermostats and zone-specific start-up per manufacturer guidelines.

All labor associated with mounting and securing indoor and outdoor units, including two multi-zone branch distribution boxes.

Labor quantity is calculated based on a three-level home with four zones of conditioned space, requiring staged equipment handling, floor-to-floor routing of refrigerant and drain lines, and commissioning across multiple mechanical locations.

All work will be performed in accordance with manufacturer specifications and applicable codes. Final system start-up, pressure testing, and operational verification are included.

Note: Electrical connections, including disconnects, dedicated circuits, and final tie-ins, are to be completed by others.

Provide all necessary materials and supplies required for the complete installation of the ducted heat pump systems and associated ventilation components. This includes, but is not limited to:

Ductwork Materials: All sheet metal ductwork, flex ducts, fittings, take-offs, dampers, collars, and hangers required to serve the four designated zones across the basement, first floor, and second floor.

Finishes & Trim: Registers, grilles, diffusers, return air panels, and all finish components for a clean, code-compliant installation throughout the home.

Installation Accessories: Line set insulation, condensate piping, vibration isolators, line supports, fasteners, sealants, adhesives, and all miscellaneous installation hardware.

ERV System: One (1) Energy Recovery Ventilator (ERV) with 150 CFM rated capacity, including power cord and advanced touchscreen wall control. The ERV system will be fully integrated into the home’s mechanical ventilation design for continuous fresh air exchange.

All materials shall be suitable for residential HVAC applications, installed in accordance with manufacturer specifications and local mechanical code requirements.

Coordination and procurement of all necessary HVAC permits required for the installation of two LG Multi-Zone heat pump systems and associated ventilation equipment, including the Energy Recovery Ventilator (ERV). This includes:

Filing of permit applications with the local building department.

Provision of all documentation required for mechanical system approval, including equipment specifications, zoning assignments, and system layout.

Coordination of required inspections to ensure full code compliance.

Inclusion of Manual J, S, and D design documentation as required by the authority having jurisdiction (AHJ) for residential HVAC permitting.

All permitting activities will be carried out in accordance with municipal regulations. Permit fees are included, and Premium HVAC Inc. will ensure all licenses and documentation are current and valid for the scope of work outlined.

This proposal outlines the supply of all Mitsubishi VRF HVAC equipment necessary for the complete installation at one residential building within the Tiverton Rhode Island Apartments project. The building scope consists of nine (9) residential apartment units, each served by an individual 3:1 VRF system, and one (1) additional 3:1 VRF system serving the common areas.

Our equipment package includes high-efficiency Mitsubishi outdoor and indoor units, factory-specified accessories, and all necessary controls to meet the project's mechanical design and performance requirements. All equipment has been selected to maximize energy efficiency, occupant comfort, system reliability, and compliance with applicable codes and standards.

Additionally, this scope includes factory-authorized and supervised start-up assistance to ensure that all systems are properly commissioned in accordance with manufacturer specifications. Accessories such as drain pan heaters, snow and hail guards, and elevated outdoor unit stands are provided to support long-term durability and optimal system performance.

This comprehensive equipment package is structured to ensure seamless integration with the project’s construction schedule, supporting a high-quality, professional installation across both residential and common area spaces.
